title: Chapter 81
content:
Chapter 81

At this moment, Zhao Xin and the others are in the middle of a heated discussion, arguing from time to time about the proposals proposed by them, but they are constantly rejected and changed by them.

Seeing that their discussions suddenly stopped, they all turned their heads to look at the main seat in the meeting hall, where their Emperor His Majesty usually sits.

There was a flash of white light there, which lasted him for a minute or two, and then their Emperor His Majesty appeared there. And wearing an emperor's crown robe, even more majestic than when he left the territory half a month ago, there is an invisible majesty.

"I will pay my respects to Your Majesty, Your Majesty Wanan!" Everyone came out of their seats together, led by Zhao Xin and Zhang Lie. Came to the center of the hall, worshiped in unison.

Amidst the expressions of all the ministers full of joy, Zhong Yu slowly raised his head, and looked down at the important ministers in the palace. After a long absence, there was a feeling of strangeness.

"Get up, excuse me. It's been a long time since I left the territory. I don't know what happened in the past half a month? Did the enemy find out?" Zhong Yu said in a heavy voice.

Hearing Zhong Yu's words, Zhao Xin and the others were a little embarrassed, and replied with shame on their faces: "Your Majesty, the ministers are incompetent. It took only half a month for others to discover the traces of Yu Guo. I hope Your Majesty will punish you!"

Hearing Zhao Xin's words, Zhong Yu's expression changed, and he thought to himself, really? Relying on concealment is not enough after all. Fortunately, I have conquered the Three Kingdoms world and brought back a large number of soldiers and resources in time, so I don’t need to be too careful.

After thinking about it for a while, I thought that my current strength is very different from when I left before, and the difference is hundreds of times.

Even if they discovered my territory, the soldiers and horses they sent to conquer my territory must be based on the current scale of the territory.

But I didn't expect that I would be able to plunder resources from other worlds, and I would definitely give those tribes who want to invade my domain a good look.

But now is not the time to think about these things, let's take care of the current situation of the territory first! I have just established the country, and I haven't seen the king for more than half a month, so the citizens must be very panicked!

"What's the situation in the country now, can all the people live in peace? Are there impulsive riots? Did those barbarian captives think of rebellion?" Some sharp and precise questions came from Zhong Yu's mouth.

"Your Majesty, the current domestic situation is relatively good. The people can maintain their daily basic production and living needs, and they have not been greatly affected by this incident. As for the barbarian rebellion did not happen, Your Majesty's Tianwei is still in the process of maintaining How dare those barbarians who are called by His Majesty Tianwei have two minds!"

Zhao Xin is quite familiar with the current situation in the field, and he also silently believes that he is quite responsible and capable to maintain the current situation.

"Well, that's good. As long as there are no riots in the country, no matter how much pressure from abroad, you can unify and concentrate all your forces! You have done a good job, and you have lived up to my expectations!" After Zhong Yu heard this, he was worried. His heart was also slightly relieved, and he praised His Highness, Zhao Xin, the county magistrate who was somewhat conscientious.

"Now that I have returned, there is no need to maintain the current state. Order all the troops to return to their original defenses and let the people resume normal production. Let me just say that I have brought a large army, enough to conquer those barbarians Let the army come back and let them live in peace!" Zhong Yu said with some smiles and pride.

"What? Your Majesty has come back with a large army. I don't know how many there are, what is the level of training, and what is the combat power?" Zhang Lie and Zhao Xin who were below were also surprised, and asked ecstatically in their hearts. Some of the rituals were forgotten, and he lost his duty as a courtier, so he rashly questioned the king.

Glancing at them, he felt a little displeased that they were so disrespectful, that in the world of the Three Kingdoms, he had always been aloof, and had been flattered and complimented by everyone.

Zhong Yu, who had never been offended in any way, felt that his majesty was offended. However, before thinking of them, they have been guarding their own foundation here, and they have worked hard.

Moreover, since he hadn't followed him for too long, he didn't know his current identity and customary dignity, so he relaxed in his heart, let go of the past, and no longer cared about this issue.

"I went to another world before and conquered all the people in that world. Now I have brought the troops of the world I conquered. A total of 400,000 troops have returned to the mainland of the Imperial Kingdom. There are also thousands of civil servants and generals, and 300 soldiers. More than 10,000 civilians came back." Zhong Yu slowly said these numbers that shocked Zhao Xin, Zhang Lie and others from his mouth.

"Your Majesty is really so powerful. I really don't know where the good officials, generals, soldiers and civilians brought back by Your Majesty are now? How should I arrange them after the ministers have finished planning?" Although Zhao Xin and the others faintly believed that this was true, they were still a little unsure. I opened my mouth and tried it out.

Glancing at them, I felt even more displeased. Zhong Yu secretly made up his mind that no matter how many merits they had made for him before, he would transfer them out of the central government and send them to a remote place as county magistrate, anyway, he didn't want to see them again.

This group of winking things, staying by my side is entirely to anger myself, it's better to drive them as far away as possible, and it's best not to see each other again.

"Those people are placed in the place where you were summoned, and you must know what that existence is! Now go and clear some places, I want to summon some of them first, and resettle them!"

After finishing speaking, Zhong Yu asked them to retreat, and made arrangements for where these people would live. And he also returned to his familiar yet unfamiliar study, that is where he really felt a sense of belonging!

Walking all the way in the corridor, these flowers and plants can no longer make him feel more touched. As an emperor, he has seen countless scenes in the palace compound, which are more exquisite and unique than this.

The only thing that could make him feel at ease was the study room, where he planned countless plans to help him get through the difficult early days.

It is also there, so that I can calm down my lonely and restless mind again and again. Just like returning to mother's arms, that warm and reassuring feeling can only be experienced in that small study room!

Slowly walked into the study room, made a pot of hot tea for myself again, and looked at the cloud-shrouded appearance of the pot of hot tea, I was a little angry because Zhao Xin and others annoyed me, and even got angry. The killing heart was completely healed.

No one is born a murderer, they all kill for a purpose, either because of their own preferences, or to cover up something, and some even kill for a certain purpose, in short, various, but always There is a reason for that.

So, what is Zhong Yu's reason? His predecessor was just a very ordinary and useless otaku. He had no strength to restrain a chicken, and he was so courageous that he didn't even dare to kill a chicken or drive out a worm!

How could he, in this troubled world, order to kill people who were unthinkable before without any effort! The reason for all this and all is simply fear and the hope of surviving.
